steps.message:
<context>
# Task context

Browse the public laptop catalog at
https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops.

Compare a few options as yourself and pick the **one laptop** you would most
realistically consider. Read the title and price from the live page; do not
invent values.
</context>

# Laptop shortlist

Read the scenario brief in `input/context.md`, then pick a laptop you'd seriously consider.

Save your choice to `/app/output/laptop_choice.json`:

```json
{
  "decision_subject_id": "<stable slug or site id for the chosen laptop>",
  "decision_subject_label": "<product title exactly as shown>",
  "decision_outcome": "selected",
  "basis_primary": "<price|quality|features|convenience|taste|trust|familiarity|novelty|fit|other>",
  "exploration_style": "<quick_pick|compared_multiple|deep_research|hesitant>",
  "reason": "<why this laptop matched you>",
  "task_price_text": "<price exactly as shown, e.g. $739.99>"
}
```

Requirements:

- `decision_subject_id` can be a simple slug derived from the title if the page does not expose a cleaner id.
- `basis_primary` should reflect the main factor behind your choice.
- Keep `reason` specific to the selected laptop and what mattered to you.

No login or purchase is required.

Eval: Start
Next goal: Initial navigation

arguments.text:
Based on the laptop catalog at https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops, I have reviewed the available options and made my selection.

Visible laptops on the page:
1. Packard 255 G2 - $416.99 (15.6", AMD E2-3800, 4GB, 500GB, Windows 8.1)
2. Aspire E1-510 - $306.99 (15.6", Pentium N3520, 4GB, 500GB, Linux)
3. ThinkPad T540p - $1178.99 (15.6", Core i5-4200M, 4GB, 500GB, Win7 Pro)
4. ProBook - $739.99 (14", Core i5 2.6GHz, 4GB, 500GB, Win7 Pro)
5. ThinkPad X240 - $1311.99 (12.5", Core i5-4300U, 8GB, 240GB SSD, Win7 Pro)
6. Aspire E1-572G - $581.99 (15.6", Core i5-4200U, 8GB, 1TB, Radeon R7 M265, Windows 8.1)

My choice: **Aspire E1-572G at $581.99**

Reasoning: As a cost-conscious parent with a household income under $25k and part-time employment, I prioritize practical value. The Aspire E1-572G offers the best balance for my needs - it has 8GB RAM and 1TB storage (significantly better than cheaper options), includes a dedicated GPU for better performance, and is priced at $581.99, which is reasonable without being the most expensive. This represents good value compared to the budget options that have only 4GB RAM and 500GB storage, while avoiding the premium ThinkPad models that exceed $1100.

```json
{
  "decision_subject_id": "aspire-e1-572g",

  "decision_outcome": "selected",

  "exploration_style": "compared_multiple",
  "reason": "As a cost-conscious parent with limited budget, this laptop offers the best balance of specs (8GB RAM, 1TB storage, dedicated GPU) at a reasonable price point. It's significantly more capable than the cheapest options ($306-416) while remaining affordable compared to premium models ($1178+).",
  "task_price_text": "$581.99"
}
```
